title: WorkflowRun
description: A single execution instance of a workflow. Tracks the progress and outcome of running a workflow's processing pipeline.

id.description: The unique identifier of the run

workflow_id.description: The identifier of the workflow that was executed

status.description: The current execution status of the run

started_at.description: The date and time the run started executing

completed_at.description: The date and time the run completed

duration_ms.description: The total run duration in milliseconds

step_results.description: The results of each step in the workflow run

input_parameters.description: The input parameters provided for this run
